definitions.full: H8632. tqoph תְּקָף noun [masculine] might ; — construct ׳בִּת חִסְנִי Dan 4:27 , of king. [ תְּקֹף ] noun [masculine] id; — emphatic תָּקְמָּא Dan 2:37 .

occurrences.englishText: You, O king, are king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given the kingdom, the power, the strength, and the glory.

Therefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable to you, and break off your sins by righteousness, and your iniquities by showing mercy to the poor. Perhaps there may be a lengthening of your tranquility.”
